title: General.
officialText:
Every boiler shall be equipped with blowoff/blowdown valve(s). The valve(s) shall be installed in the openings
provided on the boiler. The minimum quantity and size of each valve shall be the quantity and size specified by the boiler
manufacturer or the quantity and size of the boiler blowoff/blowdown valve opening.
